name: accessible-pdf
title_zh: 单文件过 WCAG 2.1 AA 的课件无障碍改造
tagline_zh: Keynote、Word 或裸 PDF 交进去，出来就是能挂 bCourses 的合规文件。
tagline_en: Drop in a Keynote, Word doc, or bare PDF—get back a bCourses-ready file fixed to UC Berkeley RTL specs, not.
desc_en: Make a single course file (Keynote deck, Word document, or bare PDF) into a WCAG 2.1 AA / ADA Title II–ready PDF for posting to students on bCourses, following UC Berkeley RTL guidance. Use when the user asks to make a file accessible, remediate a PDF, add alt text, check a PDF for Ally, or prepare slides/readings for posting. Works file-by-file.
why_zh: 它不笼统说「加 alt」，而是按 RTL 指引逐项核对标题结构、阅读顺序、颜色对比。
why_en: It follows Berkeley's RTL checklist item by item—headings, reading order, contrast—so Ally flags drop before students ever see.
limit_zh: 只处理单个文件，不批量；只认 Keynote、Word、裸 PDF 三种输入；产出到 WCAG 2.1 AA 即止。
limit_en: Single-file only; accepts Keynote, Word, or bare PDF; stops at WCAG 2.1 AA—no batch, no legal review, no human QA.
title_en: One-file WCAG 2.1 AA remediation for course materials
